title: A self-running space economy SIM in Rust and Bevy
claim: Show HN: A self-running space economy SIM in Rust and Bevy
why_good: The simulation can serve as a testing ground for economic theories and strategies in a controlled environment, attracting researchers and educators.
value: Educational institutions and game developers could pay for access to the simulation, licensing it for teaching or integration into their own products.
risk: The project may struggle to scale into a full-fledged company if it fails to attract a dedicated user base or if larger gaming companies develop similar tools.
